message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: The defendant (谭某某) hired temporary workers to make an advertisement board at a company. He had no construction qualification, did not provide safety equipment (helmet, safety rope). One worker (李某均) fell from scaffolding, suffered head injury, died. The safety supervision authority identified the responsible person as the head of the advertising engineering department, i.e., the defendant. He was arrested, confessed, and compensated the family.

This is a major responsibility accident (重大责任事故) under Chinese criminal law. The label used in earlier examples for similar cases: "重大责任事故". Indeed earlier examples: first case (浙江省宁波... ) labeled "重大责任事故". Also other similar cases (临沂... ) labeled "重大责任事故". So the correct label is "重大责任事故". No other crimes like homicide, negligence? The law: Under Chinese criminal law, causing death due to safety negligence can be charged as "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident). So label: 重大责任事故.

Thus output: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>
